name: portos
description: Local dev machine App OS portal
author: Adam Eivy (@antic|@atomantic)

scripts.dev: node scripts/checkNodeVersion.js && node scripts/checkNpmVersion.js && node scripts/dev-start.js
scripts.start: node scripts/checkNodeVersion.js && node scripts/checkNpmVersion.js && node scripts/ensure-deps.js && npm run build && node scripts/setup-db.js && node scripts/setup-cert.js && (node ./node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 delete portos-ui --silent || echo pm2 delete skipped) && node scripts/pm2-start.js portos-server,portos-cos,portos-autofixer,portos-browser
scripts.pm2:start: (node ./node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 delete portos-ui --silent || echo pm2 delete skipped) && (node ./node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 delete portos-autofixer-ui --silent || echo pm2 delete skipped) && node ./node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --only "portos-server,portos-cos,portos-autofixer,portos-browser" && node ./node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 save
scripts.pm2:restart: (node ./node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 delete portos-ui --silent || echo pm2 delete skipped) && (node ./node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 delete portos-autofixer-ui --silent || echo pm2 delete skipped) && node ./node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 restart ecosystem.config.cjs --only "portos-server,portos-cos,portos-autofixer,portos-browser" && node ./node_modules/pm2/bin/pm2 save
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
